executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $155.02 per resident day (45.8% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $16,147,697 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 46,906 Medicaid days, $344.26 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $339.95 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $348.44 for July 2025 to June 2026.

Cost year 2025: DSS's review removed $128,939 of the $510,308 management fee (page 16, line m12), leaving $381,369 in the costs DSS counts. The data shows the change, not the reason; DSS caps management fees and can remove related-party charges.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 4.9% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $314,325, 4.1% of the $7,730,480 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,303,454, $26.14 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $590,918 (45.3%), allocated fringe $233,107 (17.9%), non-wage costs $479,429 (36.8%). Raw food was $404,341 ($8.11 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Missing data: cost year 2019 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075250/financials.json.
Built only from public datasets published on danbeem.xyz. Absence of a record means it is not in these datasets, not that it did not happen.
Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2019 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; payer days do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
